notes: Pilot uses only the seed-42 outer training partition, split again by exact-text group. Outer test rows are excluded from fine-tuning, validation scoring and epoch selection. Frozen, label-free retrieval statistics retain the full-corpus reference protocol.
Both the neural model and its classical control use clipped word-class sample weighting. The pilot is exploratory model selection, not final test performance.
The last two E5 encoder blocks and a new definition-usage classification head are trained on CPU. Earlier encoder parameters remain frozen and in eval mode.
Paired definition/usage input and max length 256 differ from frozen retrieval. Frozen BM25/E5/RRF signals are concatenated to the pooled pair representation.
Best epoch is selected by inner-validation official F1 with the fixed zero-logit decision threshold. No threshold is tuned on validation labels.
A full multi-seed neural evaluation is justified only if validation F1 exceeds the matched classical control by at least 0.02.
